rows.en: Yuki-onna, become Snowgon!
Ah… It's a kaiju!!
Ugh…
Nnngh…
Hey!
Oh!? Hayata! What happened to us?
That's right! What happened to Woo?
It vanished like a phantom… It really was a legendary kaiju.
And what about Yukinko?
I hear she went back to the mountains…

I knew it…

I was thinking something like this!

That maybe the girl, Yuki the Yukinko, never really existed. That maybe the one we met was a phantom of the snowy mountain…

Maybe so…

She was a cute kid! I've got a feeling we'll never meet anyone like her ever again…
I think so too…
What? You came to this mountain too?
Yeah… though I've had it with snowy mountains…
I think so too…
Yes… though I've had it with snowy mountains…
Hello…
Oh, you made it?
How's Mari doing?

Well… Mitsuko came by a little while ago.

Apparently her energy converter was malfunctioning… but she says Mari will be back to normal before long.
Oh, thank goodness.
When Mari gets better, I'm gonna thank her.
Jiro, just don't thank her by inviting her on a picnic, okay? Especially not to a snowy mountain…
Oh, Go…
Still, those aliens sure come up with every trick in the book, don't they?
Heh heh, they sure do.
What's next, the legend of the Abominable Snowman?
Heh heh, they really do.
Next time, maybe it'll be the legend of the Abominable Snowman?
Hah hah hah…
And so… the legend of the yuki-onna came to a close. But it is only a small part of the mystery that the snowy mountains hold…
Perhaps it is an impossible dream for people to know all of it. The mountains were there long, long before humans were born…
Defeat the Legendary Monster Woo and all Gigants!
Defeat the Snow Woman Monster Snowgon!
Hayata, Ide or Arashi is defeated
Hayata or Ide is defeated
Hideki Go is defeated
<c3>Ide</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Ide</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!

What a beautiful starry night…

Only two more days now, right? Until the ultra-long-range radar you've poured your heart and soul into is finished, Kishida…

Yeah… Once it's done, it'll pick up objects three times farther away than before!

That'll put it about even with the Far East Base's long-range radar in performance…

Mind you, mine doesn't use a Yushima Diode…
And it's still just as good? That's an amazing invention. That's Kishida for you.

Nah… that's the advantage of coming later.

Come on, let's hurry home… It's gotten late tonight!
What's wrong, Go?
Didn't you hear that? A woman screaming!

…!?

Go, over there! A car's on fire!
Someone's inside! We have to get them out, quick!
All right, give me a hand!
Ugh… Grana… das…

She seems to be injured… but her life doesn't seem to be in danger.

I'll take her to the hospital and come back!
Understood.

Hahaha… You're overthinking it, Go!

That's what they call "phosphor fire." It's phosphorus in the air giving off light! It's no kaiju.
Yep, yep… When I was a kid, I was out playing at night once, saw one of those, and ran all the way home.

When it burns in a graveyard, some people call it a will-o'-the-wisp…

Anyone who sees it for the first time gets scared out of their wits!
But… there was a strange cry too.

Hehehe… There are lots of wild birds around there.

Wasn't what you heard just a bird call, Go?
Hmmm…
Speaking of which… isn't Kishida back yet?
No, sir… He went to visit that girl in the hospital.
Twice in one day? What's gotten into Kishida?
I'm sorry… I'll make sure to tell him.
Captain!
What is it?

Maybe everyone's right after all…

But please, let me look into it once more… until I'm satisfied.

All right, very well…

Ueno, go with him!
Yes, sir!

Listen, Go. Take a good look!

That's a hole left from digging gravel. It's no kaiju footprint!
I know that…

Every year, a few kids fall into the water in this hole and die. So it's also a man-eating hole!

Depending on how you look at it, you could call it a kaiju! The flames you saw might well have been the spirit of a drowned child, Go.

Maybe so… But look at this car!

The roof is crushed flat like this! Something put a lot of force on it from above.

Nope… Go, force doesn't only come from above!

Picture it flipping over once. It's no surprise if the roof, the weakest part, caved in when it did…
You're very practical, aren't you, Ueno?

Hehehe… Well, of course!

In MAT, you can't get your job done unless you're practical! Come on, let's go!
Go, maybe what you saw… was these guys after all.

Ide, Arashi… that kaiju's name is Jamila.

The truth is… he's a human being, just like us!
A human…!?
Cap! Don't joke around at a time like this.

It's no wonder you can't believe it…

Jamila was the pilot of an artificial satellite launched by a certain country…
The pilot?

uncertain: U13150: 'she' = Yuki the Yukinko; the subject is implied by U13149.
U13153/U13156: HERO4 agrees with Arashi's U13152 ('never meet anyone like her again').
U13161: Mitsuko = Mitsuko Komyoji (glossary); 'she says Mari will be back to normal' – the speaker of the prognosis is Mitsuko.
U13175: read 雪姉独獣 as 雪女怪獣; rendered 'Snow Woman Monster Snowgon' (title not in glossary).
U13193: 燐火（りんか） with its reading gloss rendered 'phosphor fire'; reading dropped.
U13216: Jamila referred to as 'he' since he was the (male) astronaut pilot in the source show; the line says he was a human like us.

new_names.why: full title not in glossary (スノーゴン=Snowgon is)
